MRI — invented by Ling's student Raymond Damadian and later refined by Paul Lauterbur — rests on Ling's physical-chemical theory of life, yet forty years later almost nobody knows Ling's name.

key_claims: Spin-lattice (T1) and spin-spin (T2) NMR relaxation times measured in six normal rat tissues and two malignant solid tumors (Walker sarcoma, Novikoff hepatoma); malignant tumors fell distinctly outside the normal range
